How to play

  • Space, Up or W jumps. Press again in the air for a double jump. On a phone, tap the scene or the Jump button.
  • Orange spikes, crates and dream orbs cost a heart. You get 1.8 seconds of safety after a hit.
  • Each gold coin adds 100 test coins. Grab coins in a row to build a score combo.
  • A run lasts 75 seconds or three hearts. It speeds up every 15 seconds, five levels in all.
  • Live mode follows the real wheel: running means a fast day lab, resting means a floaty dream. A newly settled block gives a short coin magnet.
  • If the live signal drops, the run pauses. Resume once a fresh reading arrives, or switch to practice: the live entry is refunded, its unfinished coins are dropped, and one practice entry is charged, so switching costs nothing extra.
  • Practice · simulated works offline and swaps day and dream every 20 seconds. Its records are kept apart.
